# Direction — S83

The object is a paper evidence sheet on a warm, slightly toothy surface. The camera begins close and already moving, then tracks the sheet through six turns in its life. Deep blue ink carries verified institutional information; red pencil is reserved for the BBC’s correction. Short exact source-text excerpts carry publisher and date labels. No source page, BBC photograph, or product screenshot is displayed.

The centrepiece is the note turning over at the correction. The back does not become a dashboard: it becomes a plain evidence register. The measured documentation task occupies one ruled field; the waiting-time claim occupies the other and is labelled with the BBC’s published-evidence status. Hold the difference long enough to read, then let the final before/after sheet turn the distinction into a practical method.

Keep a clear caption band separate from source credits. All meaningful source text, quotations and credits are at least 42 px in the portrait frame; timed voice captions are at least 46 px. Use the exact voice transcript, short timed groups and high contrast. No text may sit underneath the source attribution, phone illustration, stamp or pencil. The voice has paragraph-level pauses already represented in the canonical word timing; do not retime or re-record it in this source pass.

Motion follows the physical task: paper unrolls, note lines type on, pen travels, the sheet turns, and the evidence register divides. No arbitrary zoom, glitch, stock whoosh, generic UI or repeated card stack. The text-only 17-cue paper/pen plan is in `MIX-SPEC.json`; BGM was considered and no bed selected for a dry evidence-documentary tone. The cues and catalog assets still need hosted audition and source-level receipts.

**Review state:** no local programme media was opened, processed or copied. The phone and waveform are schematic, labelled illustrative and explicitly not Walsall's deployed interface. Trust logo permissions remain NOT ASSESSED, including the proposed public review copy. Hosted stills must be inspected independently against P1–P3 before creative or release approval.
